turns.text: real quick my roommate left a printed budget on the kitchen counter lol. what does a household budget usually include

A printed household budget usually covers:

- Income: take-home pay from all sources
- Fixed costs: rent, utilities, internet, phone, insurance, subscriptions
- Variable costs: groceries, transport, gas, eating out
- Debt payments, if any
- Savings: an emergency fund and any specific goals
- Personal or fun money
- A buffer line for surprises

If it's a shared place, there's often a column showing each person's share of the shared costs. Want me to look at anything specific on it?
he highlighted my rent share, 1050 a month. is splitting rent 50/50 in a two bedroom even standard

Yes, 50/50 is the most common default for a two-bedroom, especially when roommates are friends and the rooms are similar. People sometimes adjust it when:

- One bedroom is clearly bigger or has its own bathroom
- Incomes are very different
- One person uses shared space more, or has a parking spot

If the rooms are about equal, an even split is normal and fair. If you think yours is the smaller room, a $50-100 difference is a common tweak, but you don't have to bring it up.
nah rooms are about the same. how do i say i got it to him without sounding rude. dont want a lecture on budgeting

A few options, short and friendly:

1. "Saw the budget, thanks. I've got my rent covered, all good."
2. "Appreciate it, but I got it handled."
3. "All good on my end, I've got a system. Rent's on time like always."

Number 1 is probably the easiest to say without it feeling like a brush-off. Keep it light and skip the explanation.
lol ok. also how much cushion do people usually keep. i got a few hundred saved toward a goal

The common guideline is 3 to 6 months of essential expenses. For many people that's a long road, so a smaller starter cushion is a good first target: roughly one month of basics, or $1,000 or so. A few hundred saved toward a set goal is a real start. Setting a specific number and adding a little each paycheck, even automatically, tends to work well.
